## Outcome

Describe the observable change and the issue it addresses.

## Verification

- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior
- [ ] Documentation and contracts are updated
- [ ] Inputs are fictional, public, or otherwise clean-room safe
- [ ] No credentials, real customer data, or proprietary material are included
- [ ] Authority boundaries and point-in-time behavior remain explicit

## Evidence

Link test output, examples, experiment notes, or screenshots needed for review.
